plugin.name: ReportID
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: Report item identify stats to a channel, weapon dam vs aard (based on Nokfah's Report Identify)
plugin.description:
ReportID - report an item's identify stats on one line, to yourself or a channel. Based on Nokfah's Report Identify plugin.
Type: rid help

muclient.script:
require "serialize" require "aardwolf_colors" -- TruncateStyles, StylesToColours
local VERSION = "1.0"
------------------------------------------------------------------------ -- Colors: Eric's standard theme ------------------------------------------------------------------------ local CLR_TAG = "#875FFF" -- x099 brackets local CLR_NAME = "#00D7FF" -- x045 names local CLR_MSG = "#FFFFFF" -- white text local CLR_HI = "#00FF87" -- x048 highlights local CLR_NEG = "#FF0000" -- @R negatives
-- Report line colors: channel = @ codes sent to the MUD, echo = local colors local C = { tag = { channel = "@x099", echo = CLR_TAG }, val = { channel = "@W", echo = CLR_MSG }, pos = { channel = "@x048", echo = CLR_HI }, neg = { channel = "@R", echo = CLR_NEG }, pts = { channel = "@x045", echo = CLR_NAME }, }
------------------------------------------------------------------------ -- Stat tables ------------------------------------------------------------------------ -- Stat groups in report order: { identify label, short label } local STAT_GROUPS = { { {"Strength","str"}, {"Intelligence","int"}, {"Wisdom","wis"}, {"Dexterity","dex"}, {"Constitution","con"}, {"Luck","luk"} }, { {"Hit roll","hr"}, {"Damage roll","dr"} }, { {"Hit points","hp"}, {"Mana","mn"}, {"Moves","mv"} }, }
local RESISTS = { "All magic", "All physical", "Bash", "Pierce", "Slash", "Acid", "Air", "Cold", "Disease", "Earth", "Electric", "Energy", "Fire", "Holy", "Light", "Magic", "Mental", "Negative", "Poison", "Shadow", "Sonic", "Water", }
local FLAGS = { "solidified", "resonated", "illuminated" }
-- Every label that carries a +/- number, for the line parser local SIGNED_LABELS = {} for _, group in ipairs(STAT_GROUPS) do for _, s in ipairs(group) do table.insert(SIGNED_LABELS, s[1]) end end for _, r in ipairs(RESISTS) do table.insert(SIGNED_LABELS, r) end
------------------------------------------------------------------------ -- State ------------------------------------------------------------------------ local idType = GetVariable("idType") or "identify" local channel = "" local queue = {} -- items waiting: { arg = "...", bag = "..." or nil } local current = nil -- item being identified now local reports = {} -- finished { item = ..., parts = ... } local item = {} -- what the capture has read so far local section = nil -- which labelled section of the box we're in local started = false -- seen the first border of this id yet local bagId = nil local bagItems = {} local aardLevel = nil -- level from the last Type line (dam line rewrite)
------------------------------------------------------------------------ -- Small helpers ------------------------------------------------------------------------ local function trim(s) return (string.gsub(s or "", "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")) end
local function escape(s) return (string.gsub(s, "(%W)", "%%%1")) end
-- [ReportID] message, in the standard theme local function Notice(...) ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", "ReportID", CLR_TAG, "", "] ") local args = {...} for i = 1, #args, 2 do ColourTell(args[i], "", args[i + 1]) end Note("") end
------------------------------------------------------------------------ -- Aard weapon math ------------------------------------------------------------------------ -- avg dam minus an aard weapon of the same level, or nil if unreadable function AardDamDiff(level, avgDam) level = tonumber(level) avgDam = tonumber(avgDam) if level == nil or avgDam == nil or level < 1 then return nil end
-- 287-290 only happen when bonus loot dropped a 291 weapon's level if level >= 287 and level <= 291 then level = 291 end
local aard if level < 80 then aard = level * 2.5 else aard = level * 3 end return avgDam - aard end
-- Whole numbers without a decimal, halves as e.g. 2.5 function FormatNum(n) if n == math.floor(n) then return string.format("%d", n) end return string.format("%.1f", n) end
------------------------------------------------------------------------ -- Help, method, reload ------------------------------------------------------------------------ local HELP = { { "rid <item> [channel]", "report an item (also N.<item> and 'two words')" }, { "rid <item> worn [channel]", "report something you are wearing" }, { "rid bag <bag id> [channel]", "report every item in a bag" }, { "rid id | spell | lore", "how to identify (now: %s)" }, { "rid help", "this list" }, { "rid reload", "reload the plugin" }, } table.sort(HELP, function(a, b) return a[1] < b[1] end)
function ShowHelp() Note("") ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", "ReportID", CLR_TAG, "", "] ") ColourNote(CLR_MSG, "", "v" .. VERSION .. " by Eric, based on Nokfah's Report Identify") for _, h in ipairs(HELP) do ColourTell(CLR_HI, "", " " .. string.format("%-28s", h[1])) ColourNote(CLR_MSG, "", string.format(h[2], idType)) end ColourTell(CLR_MSG, "", " Weapon ids also show Average Dam ") ColourTell(CLR_HI, "", "+") ColourTell(CLR_MSG, "", "/") ColourTell(CLR_NEG, "", "-") ColourNote(CLR_MSG, "", " vs an aard weapon of that level.") ColourNote(CLR_MSG, "", " Aard: level x2.5 up to 79, x3 from 80, 287-291 count as 291.") Note("") end
function SetMethod(name, line, wildcards) local pick = wildcards[1] if pick == "id" then idType = "identify" elseif pick == "spell" then idType = "c identify" else idType = "lore" end SetVariable("idType", idType) Notice(CLR_MSG, "Identify method set to: ", CLR_HI, idType) end
function ReloadMe() Notice(CLR_MSG, "Reloading...") Execute(GetAlphaOption("script_prefix") .. 'DoAfterSpecial(1, "ReloadPlugin(\'' .. GetPluginID() .. '\')", sendto.script)') end
------------------------------------------------------------------------ -- Running a queue of identifies ------------------------------------------------------------------------ local function Busy() if current ~= nil or #queue > 0 or bagId ~= nil then Notice(CLR_MSG, "Still working on the last one, try again in a moment.") return true end return false end
local function Report(entry) local name, parts = entry.item.name, entry.parts
if channel ~= "" then local s = channel .. " " .. (name.channel or "") .. " " local last = nil -- only send a color code when the color changes for _, p in ipairs(parts) do if p.color.channel ~= last then s = s .. p.color.channel last = p.color.channel end s = s .. p.text end SendNoEcho(s) return end
ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", "ReportID", CLR_TAG, "", "] ") for _, s in ipairs(name.styles or {}) do ColourTell(RGBColourToName(s.textcolour), RGBColourToName(s.backcolour), s.text) end ColourTell(CLR_MSG, "", " ") for _, p in ipairs(parts) do ColourTell(p.color.echo, "", p.text) end Note("") end
local function FinishAll() for _, entry in ipairs(reports) do Report(entry) end reports = {} current = nil end
local function NextItem() if #queue == 0 then FinishAll() return end
current = table.remove(queue, 1) item = { flags = {} } section = nil started = false
if current.bag then SendNoEcho("get " .. current.arg .. " " .. current.bag) end
EnableTrigger("rid_capture", true) AddTimer("rid_noreply", 0, 0, 5, "", timer_flag.Enabled + timer_flag.OneShot + timer_flag.Temporary + timer_flag.Replace, "NoReply") SendNoEcho(idType .. " " .. current.arg) end
-- One item finished (or abandoned): put it back if it came from a bag, go on local function ItemDone() EnableTrigger("rid_capture", false) DeleteTimer("rid_end") DeleteTimer("rid_noreply") if current and current.bag then SendNoEcho("put " .. current.arg .. " " .. current.bag) end current = nil NextItem() end
function NoReply() Notice(CLR_MSG, "No identify output for ", CLR_HI, current and current.arg or "?", CLR_MSG, ", skipped.") ItemDone() end
function ItemIdentify(name, line, wildcards) if Busy() then return end channel = trim(wildcards.channel) reports = {} queue = { { arg = (wildcards.num or "") .. wildcards.item } } NextItem() end
------------------------------------------------------------------------ -- rid bag: read the bag with invdata, then queue every item ------------------------------------------------------------------------ function BagIdentify(name, line, wildcards) if Busy() then return end channel = trim(wildcards.channel) reports = {} bagId = wildcards.bag bagItems = {} EnableTrigger("rid_invdata_start", true) AddTimer("rid_bag_noreply", 0, 0, 5, "", timer_flag.Enabled + timer_flag.OneShot + timer_flag.Temporary + timer_flag.Replace, "BagNoReply") SendNoEcho("invdata " .. bagId) end
local function BagTriggersOff() EnableTrigger("rid_invdata_start", false) EnableTrigger("rid_invdata_line", false) EnableTrigger("rid_invdata_end", false) DeleteTimer("rid_bag_noreply") end
function BagNoReply() BagTriggersOff() Notice(CLR_MSG, "No reply reading bag ", CLR_HI, bagId or "?", CLR_MSG, ".") bagId = nil end
function InvdataStart() EnableTrigger("rid_invdata_start", false) EnableTrigger("rid_invdata_line", true) EnableTrigger("rid_invdata_end", true) end
function InvdataLine(name, line, wildcards) table.insert(bagItems, wildcards[1]) end
function InvdataEnd() BagTriggersOff() local bag = bagId bagId = nil
if #bagItems == 0 then Notice(CLR_MSG, "Bag ", CLR_HI, bag, CLR_MSG, " is empty.") return end
queue = {} for _, id in ipairs(bagItems) do table.insert(queue, { arg = id, bag = bag }) end Notice(CLR_MSG, "Identifying ", CLR_HI, tostring(#queue), CLR_MSG, " items from bag ", CLR_HI, bag, CLR_MSG, "...") NextItem() end
------------------------------------------------------------------------ -- Reading the identify box ------------------------------------------------------------------------ -- The item name, cut out of the Name line by column so its colors survive local function ReadName(line, styles) local _, labelEnd = string.find(line, "^| Name%s*: ") local closeAt = string.find(line, "%s*|%s*$") if not labelEnd or not closeAt or closeAt <= labelEnd + 1 then return end
local cut = TruncateStyles(styles, labelEnd + 1, closeAt - 1) local echo = {} for _, s in ipairs(cut) do table.insert(echo, { text = s.text, textcolour = s.textcolour, backcolour = s.backcolour }) end item.name = { channel = "@w" .. StylesToColours(cut), styles = echo } end
function CaptureLine(name, line, wildcards, styles) if not started then if string.sub(line, 1, 1) ~= "+" then return end -- wait for the top border started = true DeleteTimer("rid_noreply") end
-- Every line pushes the end back; 0.5s of quiet means the box is done AddTimer("rid_end", 0, 0, 0.5, "", timer_flag.Enabled + timer_flag.OneShot + timer_flag.Temporary + timer_flag.Replace, "CaptureEnd")
if string.sub(line, 1, 1) ~= "|" then return end
-- Fixed 11 character label field after "| "; blank on continuation lines local label = trim(string.sub(line, 3, 13)) if label ~= "" then section = label end
if label == "Id" then item.Id = string.match(line, ":%s*(%d+)") elseif label == "Name" then ReadName(line, styles) elseif label == "Wearable" then item.Wearable = string.match(line, ":%s*(%w+)") elseif label == "Score" then item.Score = string.match(line, ":%s*([+-]?%d+)") end
item.Level = item.Level or string.match(line, "%f[%a]Level%s*:%s*(%d+)") item.AvgDam = item.AvgDam or string.match(line, "Average Dam%s*:%s*(%d+)")
if section == "Flags" then for _, f in ipairs(FLAGS) do if string.find(line, "%f[%a]" .. f .. "%f[%A]") then table.insert(item.flags, f) end end end
for _, l in ipairs(SIGNED_LABELS) do local sign, num = string.match(line, "%f[%a]" .. escape(l) .. "%s*:%s*([+-])(%d+)") if num then item[l] = { sign = sign, val = num } end end end
-- Build the report line from what was read local function BuildParts() local parts = {} local function add(color, text) table.insert(parts, { color = color, text = text }) end
-- each group: open bracket, pieces, close bracket, space between groups local function group(pieces) if #pieces == 0 then return end if #parts > 0 then add(C.tag, " ") end add(C.tag, "[") for _, p in ipairs(pieces) do add(p[1], p[2]) end add(C.tag, "]") end
group({ {C.val, item.Id} }) group({ {C.tag, "lv"}, {C.val, item.Level or "?"} }) if item.Wearable then group({ {C.val, item.Wearable} }) end
if item.AvgDam then local pieces = { {C.val, item.AvgDam}, {C.tag, "dam"} } local diff = AardDamDiff(item.Level, item.AvgDam) if diff and diff ~= 0 then table.insert(pieces, {C.tag, " "}) if diff > 0 then table.insert(pieces, {C.pos, "+" .. FormatNum(diff)}) else table.insert(pieces, {C.neg, FormatNum(diff)}) end end group(pieces) end
if item.Score then group({ {C.pts, item.Score}, {C.tag, "pts"} }) end
local function statPieces(list) local pieces = {} for _, s in ipairs(list) do local label, short = s[1], s[2] local v = item[label] if v then if #pieces > 0 then table.insert(pieces, {C.tag, " "}) end if v.sign == "-" then table.insert(pieces, {C.neg, "-" .. v.val}) else table.insert(pieces, {C.pos, v.val}) end table.insert(pieces, {C.tag, short}) end end return pieces end
for _, g in ipairs(STAT_GROUPS) do group(statPieces(g)) end
local resistList = {} for _, r in ipairs(RESISTS) do table.insert(resistList, { r, string.lower(r) }) end group(statPieces(resistList))
if #item.flags > 0 then local letters = "" for _, f in ipairs(item.flags) do letters = letters .. string.upper(string.sub(f, 1, 1)) end group({ {C.pos, letters} }) end
return parts end
function CaptureEnd() EnableTrigger("rid_capture", false)
if item.Id then if not item.name then item.name = { channel = "", styles = {} } end table.insert(reports, { item = item, parts = BuildParts() }) BroadcastPlugin(1, serialize.save_simple(item)) else Notice(CLR_MSG, "Couldn't read the identify output for ", CLR_HI, current and current.arg or "?", CLR_MSG, ".") end
ItemDone() end
------------------------------------------------------------------------ -- Always on: add the aard difference to any weapon's Average Dam line ------------------------------------------------------------------------ function AardLevelCapture(name, line, wildcards) aardLevel = wildcards[1] end
local function EchoStyles(styles) for _, s in ipairs(styles) do ColourTell(RGBColourToName(s.textcolour), RGBColourToName(s.backcolour), s.text) end Note("") end
-- The game's line is hidden; print it again with " +42" / " -30" after the -- number, taking the same number of padding spaces out so the | stays put. function AardDamLine(name, line, wildcards, styles) local level = aardLevel aardLevel = nil -- use it once, never let a stale level carry over
local ok = pcall(function() local _, numEnd = string.find(line, "Average Dam :%s*%d+") local diff = numEnd and AardDamDiff(level, string.match(line, "Average Dam :%s*(%d+)"))
if diff == nil or diff == 0 then EchoStyles(styles) return end
local insert = " " .. (diff > 0 and "+" or "") .. FormatNum(diff) local insertColor = (diff > 0) and CLR_HI or CLR_NEG
-- padding after the number; keep at least one space before the | local spaces = #(string.match(line, "^ *", numEnd + 1)) local drop = math.min(#insert, math.max(spaces - 1, 0))
-- one entry per character, each with its own colors local chars = {} for _, s in ipairs(styles) do local fore, back = RGBColourToName(s.textcolour), RGBColourToName(s.backcolour) for i = 1, #s.text do table.insert(chars, { ch = string.sub(s.text, i, i), fore = fore, back = back }) end end
local out = {} for i = 1, numEnd do table.insert(out, chars[i]) end local back = chars[numEnd] and chars[numEnd].back or "" for i = 1, #insert do table.insert(out, { ch = string.sub(insert, i, i), fore = insertColor, back = back }) end for i = numEnd + 1 + drop, #chars do table.insert(out, chars[i]) end
-- print, joining neighbours that share colors local i = 1 while i <= #out do local fore, back, text = out[i].fore, out[i].back, out[i].ch i = i + 1 while i <= #out and out[i].fore == fore and out[i].back == back do text = text .. out[i].ch i = i + 1 end ColourTell(fore, back, text) end Note("") end)
if not ok then Note(line) end -- never lose the line end
------------------------------------------------------------------------ function OnPluginInstall() ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", "ReportID", CLR_TAG, "", "] ") ColourTell(CLR_MSG, "", "v" .. VERSION .. " loaded. Type ") ColourTell(CLR_HI, "", "rid help") ColourNote(CLR_MSG, "", " for commands.") end
